takeoff_timeline.root_cause: IMPLEMENTER MIS-DECLARATION, rails behaved as designed: core.model.adapter enforces plan.planned_model_calls CUMULATIVELY across every attempt of the run_id (fresh sibling read of durable attempt actuals per request; the I3-defect repair). Attempt-1's 151 durable calls count against attempt-2's plan, so planned=200 left only 49 callable contacts. The takeoff-1 repair satisfied the rails per-loop check (>=200) but missed the cumulative semantics; a correct declaration for a full BLEND + resend under the registered row (1800 calls / 2400 audio-s) would have been planned_model_calls >= 352 (151 prior + 200 loop worst case + 1 resend) and planned_speech_audio_seconds >= ~900 (399.7 prior + ~471 worst case + margin).
